name: Dadcore
summary: Even though Dadcore is rooted in the broader " Normcore " movement of the early 2010s, Dadcore originated between 2017 and 2018 when luxury fashion houses integrated these utilitarian silhouettes into their high-fashion collections.

By 2026, the aesthetic evolved to include various sub-branches that deal with themes stability, adulthood, and existential apathy in response to geopolitical uncertainty. [ 1 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Practicality, comfort, anti-consumerism, nostalgia, intentional imperfection

visualDNA.colour: Heather grey, stonewashed blue, khaki, navy, faded primary tones

fashion.Overview: Dadcore is based on intentional imperfection and a rejection of traditional tailoring. It utilizes a silhouette often described as being in a no man's land between fits, neither strictly oversized nor slim. This manifests in shapeless jeans with long rises and pleated trousers that emphasize comfort over form. Footwear is the most important element of the aesthetic. Thick-soled white sneakers, frequently referred to as "ugly sneakers" or "orthopedic shoes," are frequently used. Brands such as New Balance, Reebok, and Fila are the most common models, characterized by nylon overlays and chunky midsoles.
